property_summary: Only the admin (the deployer) may successfully call setOwner; for any caller other than the deployer the call must revert, but the mutant gates on owner, so after setOwner the (changed) owner can re-call setOwner and succeed, violating the rule.
change_summary: Replace the check 'msg.sender == admin' with 'msg.sender == owner' so ownership, not adminship, gates the call.
